name: ld-imoveis
description: Fundacao de arquitetura e testes automatizados do Sistema LD Imoveis

scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-ld-imoveis-tests "vitest run tests/rules"
scripts.validate:fast: npm run build:inspecao && npm run check:html && npm run hygiene:check && npm run security:check && npm test
scripts.validate: npm run validate:fast && npm run test:rules
scripts.build:inspecao: npm run build:inspecao-core && npm run build:inspecao-repository
